## Core Technical Stack
- **Frontend & Creative**: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Three.js, WebGL, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis Smooth Scroll, GSAP.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Next.js Server Actions, Supabase, PostgreSQL, REST & GraphQL APIs, Appwrite.
- **Engineering Discipline**: Core Web Vitals optimization, accessibility (WCAG), modular component architectures, sub-second page loads.
